ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — TVS Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Cessation — TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Ms Sasikala Varadachari as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. October 23, 2026 consequent to Completion of tenure

Allotment of Securities — TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 93,06,76,784 Bonus 6% Cumulative Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement

Record Date — TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of determining eligible shareholders of the Company who will be entitled to receive the 6% cumulative non-convertible redeemable preference shares by way of bonus has been fixed as 8th September 2026.

General Updates — TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of the certified copy of the Order dated 18th August 2026 passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, sanctioning the Scheme along with the certified copy of the Scheme
Outcome of Board Meeting — TVS Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — TVS Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Allotment of Securities — TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 65000 Non Convertible Debentures through Circular Resolution on March 24, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — TVS Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
